item.title: Popular influencer shot dead during livestream outside restaurant
item.description: Cesar Gastelum, who had more than 600,000 followers on TikTok, was broadcasting with two friends when he was killed.

item.title: Washington braces for weather that could fuel catastrophic fires
item.description: As wind conditions worsen, Washington officials are concerned that firefighters may have an even harder time containing the devastating fires burning the Spokane area. CBS News' Kris Van Cleave and Jessica Burch report.

item.title: Trump claims Strait of Hormuz deal could happen soon as Iran and Oman engage in talks
item.description: President Trump told reporters "a lot of progress had been made" on reopening the Strait of Hormuz and suggested a deal could be announced as early as Wednesday. CBS News' Natalie Brand has the details.

item.title: Perez Hilton hospitalized after livestreaming acts of self-harm, officials say
item.description: In the livestream, which has since been taken down, Hilton appears to be bloodied and in a distressed mental state.

item.description: Five states held primary elections Tuesday, including a key Democratic Senate race between Abdul El-Sayed and Haley Stevens.

item.title: White House declassifies info on secret FBI probe into Trump firing of Comey
item.description: The White House on Wednesday released information claiming the FBI opened an investigation into whether President Trump was acting as an asset for Russia when he fired FBI Director James Comey. CBS News' Jake Rosen has more.

item.title: Inside Abdul El-Sayed's primary win against Haley Stevens in Michigan
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed is projected to win his Democratic primary against Haley Stevens in Michigan, despite massive spending on ads criticizing him. CBS News' Aaron Navarro breaks down the race.

item.description: CBS News is projecting that Abdul El-Sayed will win the Democratic primary for Senate in Michigan. CBS News' Fin Gómez breaks down El-Sayed's win and other key races from Tuesday.

item.title: Trump says Strait of Hormuz deal could happen as soon as today amid talks
item.description: President Trump told reporters Tuesday evening that an announcement on the Strait of Hormuz could happen today or tomorrow, following talks between Iran and Oman.

item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says the footage shows how Russian soldiers "take pleasure in killing" civilians.

item.description: The murder trial of Lindsay Clancy wrapped its seventh day on Wednesday. Clancy has admitted to killing her three children, but her defense says she was experiencing an extreme mental health crisis at the time of their deaths. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul has more.

item.description: The Danube River is at record-low levels throughout Europe, revealing some lost historical items. Meanwhile, Hungary's only nuclear power plant is on the brink of shutdown. CBS News' Ramy Inocencio has more.

item.description: Former state health official Abdul El-Sayed faced Rep. Haley Stevens in the Democratic Senate primary in Michigan in a closely watched contest that represented the latest test of the party's divisions.

item.description: Donavan McKinney has defeated incumbent U.S. Rep. Shri Thanedar in Michigan's 13th Congressional District, CBS News projects.

item.title: Baby "cocaine hippo" linked to infamous drug lord is rescued in Colombia
item.description: Colombia has around 200 so-called "cocaine hippos" living in the wild, all of which descended from a colony brought to South America by slain cocaine kingpin Pablo Escobar.

item.title: Alarming video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian man before exploding
item.description: Russia struck Ukraine with a series of missiles overnight, killing at least 17 people, according to officials. Also, shocking video appears to show a Russian drone chasing a Ukrainian vegetable vendor before exploding and wounding him. CBS News' Aidan Stretch reports.

item.description: The impact wasn't visible to the naked eye, but photos are expected to come from a lunar satellite at a later time.

item.title: White House declassifies secret FBI probe on whether Russia was involved in Trump's Comey firing

item.title: Record-low Danube River levels threaten shutdown of Hungary's nuclear plant
item.description: Three of four units of Hungary's Paks nuclear power plant were not in operation and the fourth was operating at about 50%, as of Wednesday morning.

item.description: The White House has declassified information claiming the FBI probed whether President Trump acted as a Russian asset when he fired James Comey, a theory an administration official said wasn't backed up by evidence.

item.title: El-Sayed holds narrow lead in tight Michigan Democratic Senate primary race
item.description: Tuesday's Michigan Democratic Senate primary race remains unsettled, with progressive Abdul El-Sayed holding onto a narrow lead over moderate Haley Stevens with votes still being counted.

item.title: Exercise: Your Insurance Policy for the Future
item.description: In this episode of Healthful, Norah O'Donnell is joined by her personal trainer and fitness expert, Kira Stokes. Since they started exercising together 12 years ago, Kira pushed Norah to lift heavier weights - something Norah initially resisted. Norah has since learned that you lose up to 8-percent of your muscle mass every decade after the age of 30. The two discuss the emotional connection between movement and mental health, how to get started exercising, and what about those weighted vests! Plus - Norah answers what her favorite and least favorite exercises are. We'd love to hear what topics you want to hear covered on Healthful. Text Norah at 202-217-1107.

item.title: Nazi warships, mammoth bones emerge as Danube River dries up
item.description: Water levels on the Danube River have dropped so low that dozens of World War II German battleships – and even the remains of an ancient woolly mammoth — are emerging into view.
